visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal slider of offer cards, several visible at once, with prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.description: Black background, 32px vertical padding. Title 'Oferte #pebune' (hashtag in red) left, 'VEZI OFERTELE' link right; horizontal slider of 3 white offer cards with image, title and round arrow button; prev/next arrows.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = image only; cell 2 = title link (heading or paragraph) and an optional plain paragraph rendered as a badge (e.g. availability note)
contentPattern.description: Swipeable slider with prev/next arrows of 3 offer cards; multiple visible slides at once (card-style).

usage: Offers strip inside a dark section. The section title and "Vezi ofertele" link are default content above the block.
reuseGuidance: Use for any linked card slider (1 card on mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px). The whole card is clickable through its title link.
